# Justice Regulations The following sections explain procedure on safety inspections, citations, and enforcement of charges.
[textlink="Inspections" link="Inspections"] are investigations into departments to ensure that SOP and safe practices are upheld.
[textlink="Citations" link="Citations"] are written notices informing departments of violations of SOP given after an inspection.
[textlink="Enforcement" link="Enforcement"] outlines proper procedure in charging citations.
